# Token Issuance

> Issue your own Sui coin from an audited template in the browser: name, symbol, decimals, icon on Walrus, supply and metadata policy. The coin and its capabilities belong to your wallet.

Address: https://sui-token-issuance.meddleware.co.uk

## Documentation

- [Overview](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/onchain/token-issuance/overview)
- [User guide](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/onchain/token-issuance/user-guide)
- [Developer guide](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/onchain/token-issuance/dev-guide)
